title: The variable dimension of a variable-length array must be non-negative.
summary: Try using a value that is zero or greater.
message_templates: The variable dimension of a variable-length array must be non-negative.

title: Constructors declared with the 'new' keyword can't use '.' before the constructor name.
summary: Try replacing the '.' with a space.
message_templates: Constructors declared with the 'new' keyword can't use '.' before the constructor name.

title: Constructors declared with the 'new' keyword can't be named 'new'.
summary: Try removing the second 'new' or changing it to a different name.
message_templates: Constructors declared with the 'new' keyword can't be named 'new'.

title: Constructors declared with the 'new' keyword can't have qualified names.
summary: Try removing the class name prefix from the qualified name or removing the 'new' keyword.
message_templates: Constructors declared with the 'new' keyword can't have qualified names.

title: The class '…' doesn't have a constructor named '…'.
summary: Try invoking a different constructor, or define a constructor named '…'.
message_templates: The class '{}' doesn't have a constructor named '{}'.

title: The class '…' doesn't have an unnamed constructor.
summary: Try using one of the named constructors defined in '…'.
message_templates: The class '{}' doesn't have an unnamed constructor.
